linkedin_org_description:

description_text:
About Joveo:
Every company says they're "AI-first." We actually are. Joveo's recruitment 
advertising platform processes millions of hiring decisions through machine 
learning, real-time bidding, and predictive analytics — helping the world's 
largest employers find the right people, faster and fairer. But we're not 
done. Not even close.

Role: Graduate Data Engineer
Location: Remote

Role Overview:
We are hiring a Graduate Data Engineer to launch your career building 
the data infrastructure that powers Joveo's AI platform. You will 
write production data pipelines, learn modern data stack tools, and 
contribute to systems that process millions of data points in real time.

Key Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain batch and real-time data pipelines under senior guidance
- Write SQL and Python code for data transformation and ETL workflows
- Learn cloud data platforms (BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake) in production
- Contribute to data quality monitoring and pipeline reliability work
- Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to deliver clean, usable datasets
- Grow your skills in data modeling, orchestration, and modern data engineering practices

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Recent graduate with a Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field
- Working knowledge of Python and SQL for data manipulation
- Understanding of database fundamentals and data modeling basics
- Familiarity with any data pipeline tool, cloud platform, or big data technology is a plus
- Strong analytical thinking and attention to data correctness
- Curiosity about how data flows through real production systems

Equal Opportunity Employer:
Joveo is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an 
inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all qualified individuals 
regardless of race, color, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity 
or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, marital status, 
or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All hiring decisions 
are made solely on the basis of qualifications, skills, and demonstrated 
ability.

If your dream job is one that doesn't fit neatly into a job title — apply.
Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

description_text:
Role: Data Engineer (Remote)
Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
Payout: $50-$120/hour

Role Overview:
One of our clients, a global leader in the Artificial Intelligence industry, is seeking a skilled Data Engineer to join their team on a contract basis. In this fully remote role, you will leverage your expertise to design, implement, and manage data pipelines for complex AI agent training initiatives. As a Data Engineer, you will collaborate with talented professionals to ensure efficient data flows and high-quality training datasets.

Key Responsibilities:
• Design, implement, and manage data pipelines to support complex AI agent training initiatives.
• Collaborate closely with AI/ML engineers to ensure efficient data flows and high-quality training datasets.
• Develop and maintain scalable ETL processes using Python, MySQL, and PostgreSQL.
• Utilize Java and JavaScript to integrate diverse data sources and enable seamless data exchange.
• Contribute to the optimization of AI models through effective data management and analysis.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data quality and integrity.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
• Expertise in data engineering, coding, and AI/ML.
• Strong understanding of data pipelines, ETL processes, and data storage solutions.
• Proficiency in Python, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Java, and JavaScript.
• Experience with AI/ML model training and optimization.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

More About the Opportunity:
This is a contract opportunity with a competitive hourly rate of $50-$120. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work on a dynamic project with a talented team of professionals.

Equal Opportunity Employer:
We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.

Apply Now!

description_text:
Data Engineer – Microsoft Fabric (Contract)
Location: Remote (US-based client)
Duration: 3-month initial contract (high likelihood of extension)
Start Date: 27th April
Overview
We’re supporting a leading pharmaceutical organisation on a major data platform transformation, focused on building out a Microsoft Fabric-based environment to drive analytics, reporting, and AI-led initiatives across the business.
They’re looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to support the build and optimisation of scalable data pipelines, enabling high-quality, trusted data for downstream use.
Key Responsibilities
Design, build, and optimise data pipelines within a Microsoft Fabric / Azure-based environment
Support the development of a modern data platform (lakehouse / medallion architecture)
Integrate data from multiple sources into a centralised data platform
Develop and maintain data models to support analytics and reporting
Work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver scalable solutions
Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across pipelines
Collaborate with cross-functional teams across data, analytics, and engineering
Required Skills & Experience
4+ years experience as a Data Engineer
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric OR strong Azure data stack (Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, ADLS, Power BI)
Strong experience building ETL/ELT pipelines (Python, SQL, PySpark)
Experience with data modelling (star schema / dimensional modelling)
Experience working with large-scale data platforms / lakehouse architectures
Strong understanding of pipeline performance and optimisation
Nice to Have
Experience with Microsoft Purview / data governance / data cataloging
Experience in pharma, healthcare, or regulated environments
Exposure to real-time / streaming pipelines
Experience supporting AI / ML or analytics use cases
What They’re Looking For
Hands-on, delivery-focused engineer
Comfortable in a fast-paced environment
Strong communicator across technical and business teams
Experience contributing to modern data platforms end-to-end

description_text:
Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolver pipelines de dados (ingestão, transformação e disponibilização)

Modelar dados para analytics e suporte à tomada de decisão

Integrar APIs e sistemas externos (ex: bancos, CRMs, plataformas SaaS)

Construir soluções orientadas a dados

Aplicar IA/LLMs quando fizer sentido (ex: RAG, agentes, automações)

Participar da definição de arquitetura de dados e soluções

Trabalhar próximo ao negócio para entender problemas e propor soluções

Desenvolver POCs e evoluir soluções até produção

Garantir qualidade, performance e escalabilidade das soluções



O Que Esperamos Que Você Tenha

Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas

Experiência sólida com Python

Experiência com manipulação e modelagem de dados

Conhecimento em SQL

Experiência com integração de APIs REST

Experiência prática construindo soluções de dados

Disposição real para entender necessidades de clientes e negócios e encarar de frente com propostas e negociações de solução.

Maturidade e senioridade para conduzir conversa com pessoas em posição de alta liderança das empresas.

Desejáveis

Experiência com arquitetura de dados (Data Lake, DW, pipelines)

Experiência com cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)

Experiência com LLMs e IA aplicada (OpenAI, RAG, etc.)

Conhecimento em engenharia de software (boas práticas, testes, versionamento)

Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Celery, etc.)

Experiência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)

Conhecimento em machine learning

linkedin_org_description:
A Dadosfera está transformando a forma como médias e grandes empresas lidam com dados, Inteligência Artificial e Analytics. Nossa plataforma entrega capacidades avançadas — antes restritas a grandes empresas de tecnologia — para organizações que precisam tomar decisões mais rápidas, seguras e orientadas ao negócio.

Ao democratizar o acesso a dados confiáveis e IA aplicada, ajudamos nossos clientes a acelerar oportunidades de crescimento por meio de Dashboards, Data Apps e análises acionáveis, com impacto direto em áreas como marketing, finanças e operações.

Nossa plataforma reduz significativamente o tempo e a complexidade envolvidos na gestão de dados e de nuvem, organizando todo o ciclo de vida dos dados — da coleta e integração à análise e interação — para que os times possam focar no que realmente importa: gerar valor para o negócio.
